The '''fftssfft language''' was spoken by the [[fftssfft]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Plant/Legends|plants]] from [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Not really an articulated [[Language/Legends|language]], the fftssfft produced its hissing sounds by forcing air through tiny pores in their vegetal bodies.<ref name="COE">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/feature20081201.html|text=Castaways of Endor|int=Castaways of Endor}}</ref>
